## Permanent tuning options (kept on purpose; when to use them: PERMANENT in scripts/api_surface.py)
  --agent-guards  ingot serve; on to stop loops in agent sessions (whoever starts ingot serve for pi asks for it)
  --expert-fn-bulk  Flash-Next prefill: re-tune the bulk-read threshold when measuring prefill (SSD, cache size)
  --expert-pf-bulk  MoE prefill with SSD experts: re-tune the bulk-read threshold when measuring prefill
  --expert-pf-group  SSD-expert prefill: chunks per group; 1 to compare chunk by chunk, or re-tune for memory
  --expert-prefetch  SSD experts: read-ahead top-K; 0 to measure without read-ahead, or re-tune per model and cache
  --expert-wide  Flash-Next: wide read-ahead width; re-tune with a new cache size, SSD or prediction; 0 = no wide
  --mincore  ingot-dev fncheck: page-cache residency of the expert and PLE files, to check SSD reads are real

## Environment variables read in Sources/ (and why)
  HF_HUB_CACHE  Hugging Face cache path (huggingface_hub convention; ModelPaths)
      read in: Sources/Ingot/Loader/Paths.swift
  INGOT_MODELS  directory of models for `ingot plan` without --model (no models path is built into the code)
      read in: Sources/IngotTool/Info.swift
  INGOT_SKIP_CHECK  skips the machine requirements check (MachineRequirements; for tests only)
      read in: Sources/Ingot/Memory/MachineRequirements.swift
